name: ComplexOR Flowshop_2 9x12
note: https://github.com/xzymustbexzy/Chain-of-Experts/blob/main/dataset/ComplexOR_raw/seeds_data/Flowshop_2_data.json (9 jobs, 12 machines). Jobs renumbered into an optimal order found by trying all 9! orders (listed jobs are original jobs [6, 7, 3, 4, 2, 5, 1, 8, 9] in that order): in the original numbering the listed order has makespan 268 and the optimum is 233, and the reference only evaluates the listed order.

name: generated 4 jobs 3 machines
note: generated: 4 jobs x 3 machines, times random.randint(1, 9) row by row after Python random.seed(1), then jobs listed in an optimal order found by trying all 4! orders (listed jobs are drawn jobs [2, 3, 1, 4] in that order; the drawn order has makespan 29, optimum 28), so the fixed-order reference makespan is the optimum.
